title: authz changefeed and tuple snapshot
description: Wire shapes of GET /authz/v2/changes, GET /authz/v2/tuples and the poke infra.authz.changed.v1. The gRPC forms (ReadChanges, ReadTuples) carry the same content. Only direct tuples travel; the subject side is expanded by the consumer (EVALUATION.md, subject set).

subject.description: user:<sub> | role:<code> | dept:<path> | dept_tree:<path>. Paths start and end with /.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC, exclusive. Absent or null: never expires. Evaluated at read time; expiry needs no change entry.

changes_page.description: Answer to GET /authz/v2/changes?types=a,b&after=<revision>&limit=<1..500>. changes are in strictly increasing revision order with no gap among the requested types; next is the revision to pass as after for the following call; watermark is the member's head, so a consumer whose types saw no change still advances to it. An after the member cannot serve completely answers 410.

tuples_page.description: Answer to GET /authz/v2/tuples?type=<t>&cursor=<c>&page_size=<1..1000>. A snapshot taken at revision; every page of one walk carries the same revision. The consumer rebuilds, then reads changes after that revision.

next_cursor.description: Empty string on the last page.

poke.description: Payload of the poke infra.authz.changed.v1 on core NATS: best effort, may be lost, never persisted. Triggers an immediate bundle and changes pull.

bundle.description: True when the bundle changed, not only tuples.
